ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with minimal high-intensity (white/gray) pixels restricted to scarring. Estimated high-to-low ratio is less than 0.05.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous solid black field across the entire fluke. No large white geometric blobs or mottling present. Sparse, localized high-contrast white pixel clusters corresponding to surface markings are distributed unevenly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped indentation with an estimated internal angle of 85-90 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 10 percent of the central vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration across the trailing edge with medium frequency and low amplitude. Significant jaggedness and peak variation are observed at the outer tips and approaching the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave sweep from the median notch extending towards the tips. Visible leading edges follow a broad convex trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular white-on-black pixel clusters (2-5 pixels in diameter) distributed randomly across the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several white linear disruptions visible, including horizontal marks on the mid-left lobe and vertical/oblique rake-like streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Light-colored, textured irregular masses are attached to the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization or parasitic lesions.
